description: Header file defining structures, function prototypes, and macros for error concealment of pitch and codebook gains in AMR speech codec.

methods.name: ec_gain_code_reset
methods.description: Resets the state memory for code gain concealment.

methods.name: ec_gain_code
methods.description: Conceals the codebook gain during bad frame conditions.

methods.name: ec_gain_code_update
methods.description: Updates the code gain concealment state, limiting gain if previous frame was bad.

methods.name: ec_gain_pitch_reset
methods.description: Resets the state memory for pitch gain concealment.

methods.name: ec_gain_pitch_exit
methods.description: Frees memory used for pitch gain concealment state.

methods.name: ec_gain_pitch
methods.description: Conceals the pitch gain during bad frame conditions.

methods.name: ec_gain_pitch_update
methods.description: Updates the pitch gain concealment state, limiting gain if previous frame was bad.
